description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the minimum final displacement error (minFDE₂₀) and the ratio of training data used for different trajectory prediction models. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio," represents the proportion of training data, ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, and is plotted on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "minFDE₂₀ (←)", measures the minimum final displacement error in meters, with values ranging from 18 to 23, also on a linear scale. The plot includes five distinct lines, each representing a different model: Head Tuning (blue, solid line with circular markers), FT (orange, solid line with circular markers), LoRA 16 (red, solid line with circular markers), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line with circular markers). The Head Tuning line starts at approximately 20.4 at a ratio of 0.2 and shows a steady decline to about 18.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The FT line begins at around 22.3 at a ratio of 0.2 and gradually decreases to approximately 21.1 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 16 line starts at about 23.0 at a ratio of 0.2 and decreases to roughly 22.2 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 64 line begins at approximately 23.0 at a ratio of 0.2 and declines to about 22.1 at a ratio of 1.0. A sixth line, labeled "FT" in the legend but represented by green circular markers, appears to be an outlier, starting at around 22.3 at a ratio of 0.2 and decreasing to approximately 21.0 at a ratio of 1.0. The legend, positioned in the upper right corner, identifies each line with its corresponding color and marker.
